1.description: Business Bench Polygranite Sheets are eventually utilized to decorate interior walls in both commercial and residential buildings. These sheets are ideal for use in restaurants, theatres, offices, hotels, clubs, hospitals, and hallways. With numerous advantages, Business Bench brings Polygranite Sheets to the market.

attributes.label: Material
attributes.value: PVC And Calcium Carbonate, Mimicking Natural Granite Or Marble.

attributes.label: Application
attributes.value: Ideal for interior walls in both commercial and residential spaces.

attributes.label: Function
attributes.value: Enhances living rooms, Bedrooms, and accent walls with a premium granite-like finish while seamlessly refreshing old surfaces with minimal effort.

attributes.label: Advantages
attributes.value: Water Resistant, Durable, Low Maintenance, Cost-Effective & Termite-Resistant.

attributes.label: Life time
attributes.value: 20-25 Years with proper care.

attributes.label: Installation
attributes.value: Easily installed using Adhesive, With minimal surface preparation required.

attributes.label: Accessories
attributes.value: PVC Border, PVC Internal Corner, PVC L Corner & Aluminium Accessories

2.description: Stone Panels are durable cladding solutions crafted from natural or composite stone, offering a premium aesthetic for both interior and exterior surfaces. Known for their weather resistance, fire safety, and long lifespan, they enhance structural beauty while requiring minimal maintenance, making them ideal for feature walls, and outdoor landscapes.

attributes.label: Material
attributes.value: PVC & Calcium Carbonate, Mimicking Natural Granite Or Marble, With Visual & Physical Texture.

attributes.label: Application
attributes.value: Suitable for both commercial & residential interior wall cladding.

attributes.label: Function
attributes.value: Enhances aesthetics, provides insulation, durability & weather resistance.

attributes.label: Advantages
attributes.value: Long-lasting, Low-maintenance, Fire-Resistant, Adds Premium Look.

attributes.label: Life time
attributes.value: Can last over 30 years with proper installation & care.

attributes.label: Installation
attributes.value: Fixed with Adhesives & Aluminum Accessories.

3.description: WPC (Wood-Plastic Composite) interior panels are an eco-friendly and versatile wall cladding solution. Known for their durability, aesthetics, and low maintenance, WPC panels are widely used in modern interior design for both residential and commercial spaces.

attributes.label: Material
attributes.value: Wood fibre, Plastic, Additives, Pigments, and UV stabilizers.

attributes.label: Application
attributes.value: Interior wall cladding, ceiling panels, partitions.

attributes.label: Function
attributes.value: Moisture-resistant, durable, and decorative interior surface material.

attributes.label: Advantages
attributes.value: Water-resistant, Durable, Low maintenance, Cost-effective & Termite-resistant.

attributes.label: Life time
attributes.value: 20 years according to proper installation & area of usage.

attributes.label: Installation
attributes.value: Easy to cut, screw, and nail. Requires standard tools and adhesive for mounting.

4.description: WPC (Wood Plastic Composite) panels are decorative wall panels with a vertical fluted design that creates a visually striking effect, giving walls and facades a contemporary appearance.

attributes.label: Material
attributes.value: Composed of wood-plastic composite (WPC), combining wood fibres and thermoplastics for enhanced durability and aesthetics.

attributes.label: Application
attributes.value: Ideal for exterior cladding, decking, fencing, and landscaping; suitable for residential and commercial projects.

attributes.label: Function
attributes.value: Provides weather resistance, insulation, and protection against UV rays, moisture, and pests.

attributes.label: Advantages
attributes.value: Eco-friendly, available in various colours and finishes, and resistant to warping and fading.

attributes.label: Life time
attributes.value: 25–30 years with proper care and maintenance.

attributes.label: Installation
attributes.value: Installed using hidden fasteners or clips for a seamless appearance, with straightforward alignment and securing methods.

attributes.label: Accessories
attributes.value: L Corners (Available in our pattern colour).

5.description: SPC (Stone Plastic Composite) Flooring is revolutionizing the flooring industry with its robust construction and versatile applications. Designed with a rigid core made from natural limestone powder, PVC, and stabilizers, SPC flooring offers superior durability, stability, and waterproof performance.

attributes.label: Material
attributes.value: Stone Powder, PVC Powder & IXPE Pad.

attributes.label: Application
attributes.value: Flooring for both commercial and residential spaces.

attributes.label: Function
attributes.value: 100% waterproof, scratch & stain-resistant, soundproof, comfortable, and easy maintenance.

attributes.label: Advantages
attributes.value: Affordable price, safe, beautiful, durable, easy installation & environmental protection.

attributes.label: Life time
attributes.value: 20 years with proper care.

attributes.label: Installation
attributes.value: Click-lock system (no glue or nails). Can be installed over existing flooring and requires expansion gaps for stability.

attributes.label: Accessories
attributes.value: Skirting line, reducer, stair nose & T-shape mould.

specification.label: Thickness:
specification.value: 6.5 mm (5 mm SPC core + 1.5 mm IXPE Pad)

6.description: Soffit panels cover the underside of eaves and roof overhangs, combining aesthetic appeal with practical benefits to enhance building exteriors.

attributes.label: Material
attributes.value: Typically made from PVC with embossed wood texture or wooden designs.

attributes.label: Application
attributes.value: Ceilings of porches or patios, balconies; enhances aesthetics and shields structural supports from exposure.

attributes.label: Function
attributes.value: Provides ventilation to attic spaces, protects rafters from moisture, and enhances curb appeal.

attributes.label: Advantages
attributes.value: Low-maintenance, resistant to rot and insects, available in various styles and colours.

attributes.label: Life time
attributes.value: Generally lasts 20–40 years, depending on material and environmental conditions.

attributes.label: Installation
attributes.value: Installed using aluminum channels along with a combination of accessories and fasteners.

attributes.label: Accessories
attributes.value: H-Channel, J-Channel, Inner Corner & Outer Corner.

Made from weather-resistant materials, they provide a modern fluted texture, ensuring a sleek finish while protecting structures from moisture, heat, and pests. Ideal for soffit applications in residential and commercial spaces.

attributes.label: Material
attributes.value: 97% PVC Raw material

attributes.label: Application
attributes.value: Perfect for ceilings, balconies, porches, and transitional indoor, outdoor areas.

attributes.label: Function
attributes.value: Best suited for modern homes, resorts, showrooms, and semi-open spaces.

attributes.label: Advantages
attributes.value: They add premium aesthetics, provide insulation, and require very low maintenance.

attributes.label: Life time
attributes.value: 15 Years

attributes.label: Installation
attributes.value: Easy to install using clips or screws on basic framing, ensuring a seamless finish.

attributes.label: Accessories
attributes.value: H-Channel, J-Channel, Inner Corner & Outer Corner.

9.description: PU (Poly Urethane) Stone Panels are cutting-edge building materials that offer the perfect blend of aesthetics and practicality. These light weight, durable panels are designed to replicate the natural beauty and texture of traditional stone with added modern benefits.

attributes.label: Material
attributes.value: Polyurethane (PU)

attributes.label: Application
attributes.value: Wall Panelling, Lobby Areas, Feature Walls, Interior.

attributes.label: Function
attributes.value: Water-Proof, Anti-corrosion, Anti-Insect & Heat insulation.

attributes.label: Advantages
attributes.value: Affordable Price, Safe, Attractive, Durable, Easy Installation & Environmentally friendly.

attributes.label: Life time
attributes.value: 20-30 years, Depending on Installation & Exposure.

attributes.label: Accessories

As the world shifts towards greener and healthier living environments, these boards stand out for their unique combination of environmental benefits, functional features & stylish design.

attributes.value: Bamboo Fibre Solid Board, PET, PU, PP, PVC film, Stone Powder, Wood Powder & PVC.

attributes.value: Water-Proof, Fire-Proof, Moisture Proof, Heat Insulation, Anti-Corrosion & Anti-Insect.

11.description: Wallpaper is a versatile decorative material used to enhance interior spaces, offering a wide range of colours, patterns, and textures. Made from paper with 210 GSM, it is commonly used on one wall to create a focal point, drawing attention and adding depth to a room.

attributes.label: Material
attributes.value: Made from paper with 210 GSM & non-woven, offering diverse textures & finishes.

attributes.label: Application
attributes.value: Used for interior wall decoration in residential, commercial, and institutional spaces, providing a range of design possibilities.

attributes.label: Function
attributes.value: Adds visual interest and complements interior themes, providing a sleek and polished appearance.

attributes.label: Advantages
attributes.value: Available in a wide array of colours and patterns, easy to clean, and can be used to hide wall imperfections.

attributes.label: Life time
attributes.value: 5-15 years or more, depending on the area of application and maintenance.

attributes.label: Installation
attributes.value: Applied using paste or adhesive, often requiring specific techniques for alignment and smoothing.

specification.label: Patterns:
specification.value: 51 Patterns in Model 1 | 6 Patterns in Model 2

12.description: Stone Coated Steel Roofing is a durable roofing solution that combines the strength of steel with the aesthetic appeal of natural stone. Light weight, weather-resistant, and energy-efficient, it offers long-lasting protection with minimal maintenance.

attributes.label: Material
attributes.value: Made from galvanized steel layer with natural stone chips bonded by acrylic resin.

attributes.label: Application
attributes.value: Used in residential, commercial, and public buildings, especially in harsh climates.

attributes.label: Function
attributes.value: Provides weather protection, thermal insulation, noise reduction, and fire resistance.

attributes.label: Advantages
attributes.value: Light weight, durable, low-maintenance, eco-friendly & aesthetically versatile.

attributes.label: Life time
attributes.value: 40-70 years, or more than 50 years with proper maintenance.

attributes.label: Installation
attributes.value: Overlapping of panels with fasteners, frame works & proper sealing.

attributes.label: Accessories
attributes.value: Flat Sheet, Eaves Flashing, Valley Gutter, Ridge Cap, Barge Board, 3 Way Ridge & side Flashing.
